releases.summary: Introduced concise image and video prompts.

changes.title: Crisp generation prompts
changes.before: Prompts contained long descriptions and multiple scene instructions that image and video providers struggled to follow.
changes.after: Prompts focus on one subject, one visual idea and concise provider-ready instructions.
changes.reason: Improve provider comprehension and reduce irrelevant output.
changes.user_impact: Users receive shorter editable prompts and more focused generations.
changes.rollback_effect: Restores the older long-form prompts. Existing generated media remains available.

changes.title: Person, product, ad and logo asset actions
changes.before: Uploaded reference assets did not have clear image and video preparation actions.
changes.after: Users can upload multiple role-specific assets and prepare either an image prompt or an image-to-video prompt.
changes.reason: Support product advertising and branded image-to-video workflows.
changes.user_impact: Four upload columns and two preparation buttons become available.
changes.data_impact: Uploads remain temporary and are not added to persistent storage.
changes.rollback_effect: Removes role-specific preparation buttons but does not delete previously generated files.

releases.summary: Separated worldwide category discovery from Viralizer reporting.

changes.title: Two-stage category intelligence
changes.before: Selecting a category contacted Viralizer immediately and displayed one report.
changes.after: The application first discovers public worldwide topics. Viralizer is contacted only after a user selects a topic.
changes.reason: Show a broad choice of current stories while conserving Viralizer analysis calls.
changes.user_impact: Users see topic cards first and choose which story receives a Viralizer report.
changes.data_impact: No migration. Category discoveries are returned in memory.
changes.rollback_effect: Returns to immediate Viralizer analysis and removes worldwide topic cards.

releases.summary: Sent actual uploaded pixels to reference-image generation.

changes.title: Actual reference images used by ChatGPT Image
changes.before: Uploads were converted into a text description and image generation did not receive their actual pixels.
changes.after: Uploaded thumbnail and role assets are transmitted to the OpenAI image-edit endpoint as a real visual reference.
changes.reason: Preserve the selected person, product and branding.
changes.user_impact: Generated images visibly relate to uploaded source material.
changes.data_impact: Reference files are processed temporarily and are not permanently stored.
changes.rollback_effect: Reference generation returns to text-only prompts. Existing images are preserved.

releases.summary: Created new scenes instead of copying thumbnail composition.

changes.title: Distinct reference-based composition
changes.before: The generated image closely copied the uploaded thumbnail layout.
changes.after: The subject and branding are preserved while scene, camera angle, background, pose and composition are changed.
changes.reason: Create an original image rather than a near-duplicate thumbnail.
changes.user_impact: Outputs remain recognisable but appear visually different.
changes.rollback_effect: Reference output may again closely follow the original layout.

changes.title: Infographics image button
changes.before: Users could generate social images but could not convert all report fields into one infographic.
changes.after: A button below Tags and Keywords builds an editable infographic prompt from titles, hooks, KPIs, outline, creator angle, CTA and tags.
changes.reason: Turn topic intelligence into a downloadable information graphic.
changes.user_impact: Adds an Infographics image action and confirmation workflow.
changes.data_impact: Generated images are returned to the browser; report format is unchanged.
changes.rollback_effect: Removes infographic preparation and generation without affecting other image tools.

releases.summary: Added precise five-word YouTube topic terms.

changes.title: Entity-led YouTube search terms
changes.before: Long news headlines were displayed and sent to Viralizer.
changes.after: Each story receives a company, product, brand, celebrity or country-led term of five words or fewer, with an alternate when useful.
changes.reason: Make YouTube and Viralizer searches precise and meaningful.
changes.user_impact: Cards show a short search term while retaining the full news headline for context.
changes.data_impact: Adds response fields only; no persistent migration.
changes.rollback_effect: Restores full-headline report searches and removes short YouTube terms.

releases.summary: Expanded reputation discovery into multiple signal searches.

changes.title: Detailed good and bad reputation queries
changes.before: Apps with Bad reputation used the literal query 'Apps Bad reputation' and could return one weak result.
changes.after: Bad reputation runs complaint, legal/regulatory and security/fraud searches. Positive reputation uses praise, growth and satisfaction searches.
changes.reason: Find a broad set of meaningful reputation stories.
changes.user_impact: Up to 30 deduplicated results are displayed instead of one literal-match result.
tests: Live public-news counts: 74, 100 and 100 raw results
changes.rollback_effect: Restores the narrow literal reputation query and two-day search window.

changes.title: Newest topics first
changes.before: Source-signal count was the primary sort key, allowing an older story to appear first.
changes.after: Publication date is the primary sort key and signal count breaks equal-date ties.
changes.user_impact: Newest topics appear at the top and cards show relative freshness.
changes.rollback_effect: Restores signal-first sorting and removes freshness emphasis.

releases.summary: Current stable production baseline with dated extended-news details.

changes.title: Dated extended news view
changes.before: Topic cards displayed limited source information and no expandable news details.
changes.after: Cards prominently display publication date and provide an extended view with full headline, feed summary, exact time, search term and original links.
changes.reason: Let users inspect the evidence before requesting a Viralizer report.
changes.user_impact: Adds an expandable Extended view and Open full news links.
changes.data_impact: Adds a summary field to in-memory topic responses. No migration required.
changes.rollback_effect: Removes expanded news details and prominent exact dates while preserving discovery and report generation.

releases.summary: Private release governance dashboard under development.

changes.title: Detailed private release dashboard
changes.before: Change details and rollback targets existed only in conversation and Git history.
changes.after: A private dashboard displays environments, versions, before/after details, affected files and endpoints, tests and rollback previews.
changes.reason: Give administrators a reliable record of exactly what changed and what a rollback would remove.
changes.user_impact: No regular-user interface change. The dashboard requires a separate administrator password.
changes.data_impact: Adds a versioned release catalog. No user content or report migration.
changes.rollback_effect: Removes only the private dashboard and release-catalog endpoints. Production studio features remain unchanged.

releases.summary: Free Render beta configuration without persistent storage.

changes.title: Free ephemeral beta service
changes.before: The beta Blueprint requested a persistent Render disk, which required payment information.
changes.after: The beta uses Render's free service plan and temporary storage under /tmp. Production storage is unchanged.
changes.reason: Allow private feature testing without creating a paid beta service.
changes.user_impact: Beta reports and uploads can disappear after a restart. Production users and production data are unaffected.
changes.data_impact: Beta-only data is ephemeral. Never use the beta service as the only copy of important reports.
changes.rollback_effect: Restores the paid persistent-disk requirement for beta. Production remains unchanged.

releases.summary: Search every category inside a selected super category.

changes.title: All categories super-category discovery
changes.before: The Category dropdown required one specific category, so users had to repeat discovery separately for every category under a super category.
changes.after: The Category dropdown starts with All categories and searches every category belonging to the selected super category, then combines and freshness-ranks the worldwide results.
changes.reason: Provide complete super-category coverage in one user action.
changes.user_impact: Users can discover topics across an entire super category while retaining the existing focused category and subcategory choices.
changes.data_impact: Adds an optional categories array to the request and categories_searched to the response. No stored-data migration.
changes.rollback_effect: Removes the All categories option and restores one-category-at-a-time discovery. Existing reports and production remain unchanged.

releases.summary: Simple confirmed production update and rollback controls.

changes.title: Update and rollback buttons
changes.before: Administrators could preview changes and rollback impact but had to ask for manual Git operations to publish or restore production.
changes.after: The private dashboard provides Update production and Rollback production buttons. Each displays the exact version and requires a typed confirmation before updating the GitHub main branch.
changes.reason: Make approved releases and emergency restoration simple while retaining explicit safeguards.
changes.user_impact: Only authenticated administrators see the controls. Regular studio users see no interface change.
changes.data_impact: No report or media migration. The actions change the GitHub main branch commit, which triggers Render production deployment.
changes.rollback_effect: Returns the dashboard to preview-only controls. Existing Git tags and release evidence remain available.

releases.summary: Explainable good, bad, mixed and neutral labels for worldwide topics.

changes.title: Reputation labels on topic cards
changes.before: All-category discovery combined many stories without indicating which appeared positive, negative, disputed or neutral.
changes.after: Every worldwide topic card shows a color-coded Good news, Bad news, Mixed / debate or Neutral label. Extended view lists the headline and summary signals used for the label.
changes.reason: Help users scan broad all-category results and quickly find reputation opportunities.
changes.user_impact: Adds a visible editorial label without hiding or reranking any discovered story.
changes.data_impact: Adds reputation_label and reputation_signals to in-memory topic responses. No migration.
changes.rollback_effect: Removes the labels and explanation fields while preserving all topic results and source links.

releases.summary: Category, entity and entity-type labels on worldwide results.

changes.title: Topic origin and entity labels
changes.before: Broad results showed reputation but did not state which selected category or central entity each story belonged to.
changes.after: Each card shows Category, Entity and Type labels. All-category searches score the headline and summary against every selected category, while focused searches retain the exact selected category.
changes.reason: Let users identify the source category and main subject without opening every result.
changes.user_impact: Adds three compact labels and an explainable category-assignment note in Extended view.
changes.data_impact: Adds category_label, category_match, entity_label and entity_type_label response fields. No migration.
changes.rollback_effect: Removes category and entity labels while preserving reputation labels, topics and source links.

releases.summary: Fixed homonym category matches and reputation substring errors.

changes.title: Context-aware labels and dropdown entity type
changes.before: Weather watches could be labeled Fashion > Watches, the word issued could trigger the negative signal sued, and Everything was displayed as General entity.
changes.after: Reputation signals require whole words, ambiguous categories require supporting context, unrelated all-category results are excluded, and Type displays the actual entity dropdown value.
changes.reason: Prevent misleading category and reputation labels in broad discovery.
changes.user_impact: Weather alerts no longer appear as fashion watches; entity type matches the user's selection.
changes.data_impact: No migration. Some previously displayed irrelevant homonym results are filtered from broad searches.
changes.rollback_effect: Restores loose substring matching and may reintroduce irrelevant homonym results.
